notes.title: Thank you!
notes.content:
Dear Players!
It’s been five days since CarGo! launched, and already over 200 people have played our game on Steam. We want to thank each and every one of you for your support!

If you've had a chance to play CarGo!, we’d love to hear your thoughts in a review on the game’s page. Every review is incredibly valuable to us, and we’re happy to respond to any questions or consider your suggestions.

We’re super excited, as our small student project has become our first full-fledged game, made possible thanks to Cleversan Games. Thank you for the chance to meet at gamedev events and for your invaluable feedback!

We’ve worked on CarGo! for the past 1.5 years with a very small team. We’d also like to take this opportunity to thank the entire Memory Leak Games team for all their hard work in bringing CarGo! to life!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272780/CarGo/

It can be played with up to 4 friends. 🎮🎮🎮🎮
It also works well as a party game. 

CarGo! is a chaotic couch co-op for up to four players. Working as a team of couriers try to collect and deliver as many goods as possible while keeping an eye out for time, traffic and roadworks!

notes.title: CarGo! at PAX West!
notes.content:
Beep! Beep! 

CarGo! will be showcased at PAX West in Seattle! 🎉 Visit us at Games From Poland Booth to experience our game firsthand. As a thank you for playing and/or adding the game to your wishlist, we’ll be giving away exclusive CarGo! stickers!

To celebrate, we've also released a freshly updated demo. Head over to our Steam page to try out the new features and improvements.

We can’t wait to see you at PAX West and hear your feedback on the demo!

Stay tuned for more updates and see you in Seattle!
